concerns.text: Plan cites HCP parquet URLs and NIH CSV URLs as verified sources, but explicitly states 'NO VERIFIED SOURCE FOUND' for both fMRI time-series and Flexibility scores. The plan then proposes Phase 0 will 'detect missing variables' and halt — but this is not a viable research plan. A plan cannot cite a dataset as verified when the citation itself documents that the dataset lacks the required variables.

Phase 0 is designed to fail gracefully by writing gap_report.md and exiting. This is not a research implementation — it is a contingency for missing data. The plan must either (a) identify and cite REAL verified sources that contain both HCP resting-state fMRI time-series AND NIH Toolbox DCCS scores, or (b) explicitly state that the project cannot proceed and recommend closure.

The mitigation states 'If an open dataset that includes both modalities becomes available, the plan can be updated' — this defers the core data problem to a hypothetical future. A plan must cite actual, accessible datasets. Deferring dataset discovery to post-planning is not a mitigation; it is an admission that the plan is not yet feasible.

The plan references 'Verified Datasets block' in quickstart.md and research.md but no such block appears in any artifact. The plan states 'see Verified Datasets block' but the block is absent. Either add the block with real URLs or remove the reference.

The plan cites 'Human Connectome Project, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_Connectome_Project' as the source for '1,200 healthy adults' and '≥ 800 usable subjects.' Wikipedia is not a primary source for dataset availability or sample size. Cite the official HCP data release documentation (e.g., the HCP 1200 Subjects Release notes from the HCP website) instead.

Multiple rows in the CPU cost table show '[deferred]' for estimated time (e.g., 'Parcellation (200 regions): [deferred]'). Per spec 020/023, [deferred] is sanctioned for planning docs when the metric is named and the reference is clear. However, the table does NOT name the reference or measurement method for these deferred values — it only says '[deferred]' with no surrounding context. Add a note explaining what will be measured and how (e.g., 'wall-clock time on a 2-core CI runner').

The entity lists 'Motion_Noise_Residual' as an attribute but the plan does not explain how this is computed. Phase 4 mentions 'motion-noise orthogonalization' but no algorithm is given. Either define the computation or remove the attribute from the schema.
Typo: 'FDR_Appplied' should be 'FDR_Applied' (double 'p'). This will cause schema validation to fail if the code produces the correctly-spelled field.
